title: Clash between Chilled Water Riser and Transfer Girder TG-04

input.extracted_text:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)
RFI Number: RFI-2026-001
Subject: Clash between 600mm Chilled Water Riser and Transfer Girder TG-04 at Level 02
Contract Reference: CON-2026-CS-001
Drawing Reference: DR-S-201, DR-M-402
Raised Date: 2026-02-10
Due Date: 2026-02-17
Status: answered

QUESTION:
Coordinated BIM model review reveals that the 600mm diameter chilled water supply/return risers shown on DR-M-402 physically intersect post-tensioned transfer girder TG-04 (Gridline 4-D) shown on DR-S-201. Core drilling through girder TG-04 is prohibited due to high post-tensioning tendon congestion. Please provide engineering direction on riser diversion or structural sleeve allowance.

RESPONSE:
Response Date: 2026-02-14
Confirmed: Do not sleeve or drill transfer girder TG-04. Offset chilled water risers 1200mm westward into adjacent service riser shaft S-02 per structural sketch SK-S-201-A. Mechanical subcontractor to submit revision for additional 90-degree elbows and pipe length.

expected.reasoning: Standard Request for Information containing technical question, drawing references, and answered response.

title: Curtain Wall Seismic Joint Displacement Clearance

input.extracted_text:
TECHNICAL REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
RFI Number: RFI-2026-003
Subject: Curtain Wall Seismic Joint Displacement Clearance at Tower Expansion Joint
Contract Reference: CON-2026-FAC-005
Raised Date: 2026-03-05
Due Date: 2026-03-12
Status: answered

QUESTION:
Architectural detail 4/A-501 specifies a 50mm expansion joint between the Podium and Main Tower. However, Structural General Notes S-001 indicate maximum inter-story drift under Seismic Design Category D of 75mm. Please confirm whether the facade expansion joint width must be enlarged to 85mm to prevent glass shattering.

RESPONSE:
Response Date: 2026-03-09
Approved: Increase expansion joint width to 90mm at all tower interface lines. Contractor to submit revised silicone bellows extrusion profile.

expected.reasoning: RFI resolving discrepancy between architectural joint detail and structural seismic drift criteria.

title: Rebar Lap Splice Length in High Moment Plastic Hinge Zone

input.extracted_text:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION
RFI Number: RFI-2026-004
Subject: Clarification on Column Rebar Lap Splice Length in Seismic Critical Region
Contract Reference: CON-2026-CS-001
Raised Date: 2026-03-15
Due Date: 2026-03-22
Status: answered

QUESTION:
Drawing S-104 shows lap splices of 32mm vertical rebar located at slab level in Column C-12. Per ACI 318 Section 18.7.4.3, lap splices in special moment frames are prohibited within the plastic hinge region (within 600mm or d of the joint face). Please confirm if mechanical type-2 couplers must be used instead.

RESPONSE:
Response Date: 2026-03-18
Confirmed: Replace all lap splices in Columns C-08 through C-16 at Levels 1-4 with Type 2 seismic mechanical couplers.

expected.reasoning: RFI clarifying seismic rebar splice code compliance.
